trait_ama_school_necromancy_info: Vital force: grants health and damage. Drain spells use the experimental executor.
trait_ama_wizard_info: Scholarly magic with health, damage and attack speed. Casting requires learned spells; this trait grants no instant spells.
trait_ama_sorcerer_info: Innate magic with health, damage and attack speed. Experimental learning gradually awakens an origin and develops its spells. Bloodline inheritance is still in development.
trait_ama_school_conjuration_info: Sustained manifestation: grants health, damage and attack speed. Specific summons are in development.
trait_ama_school_illusion_info: Illusory defense: grants armor and attack speed. Specific evasion mechanics are in development.
trait_ama_school_enchantment_info: Influence and precision: grants damage, armor and attack speed. Enemy control is in development.
trait_ama_school_evocation_info: Elemental power: grants damage. Current autonomous study teaches four early spells in this school.
trait_ama_school_transmutation_info: Physical transformation: grants health, damage and armor.
trait_ama_school_divination_info: Tactical perception: grants armor and attack speed.
trait_ama_warlock_info: Pact magic with health, damage and armor. Experimental learning prepares a ritual, forms a pact and develops its spells. Patron obligations and negotiations are still in development.
trait_ama_school_abjuration_info: Protection and endurance: grants health and armor. The grimoire groups each school with its highest learned circle.
ama_grimoire_info: Schools, magic circles, attributes and learned spells.
ama_masteries_info: Class status, rank, XP, attributes and learned techniques.
trait_ama_patron_fiend_info: Destructive power: health and damage, plus 10 arcane mana. Fire and vital energy curriculum. WorldBox adaptation; patron obligations are in development.
trait_ama_patron_archfey_info: Fey power: armor and attack speed, plus 15 arcane mana. Manifestation and transformation curriculum. Dedicated teleport and enchantment mechanics are in development.
trait_ama_patron_celestial_info: Protective power: health and armor, plus 15 arcane mana. Protection and manifestation curriculum. Dedicated celestial healing is in development.
trait_ama_patron_great_old_one_info: Unusual knowledge: damage and attack speed, plus 30 arcane mana. Manifestation and vital energy curriculum. Telepathy and fear mechanics are in development.
trait_ama_origin_draconic_info: Natural health and armor, plus 10 arcane mana. Elemental and protective magic. Breath and cross-generation inheritance are in development.
trait_ama_origin_wild_info: Arcane power, plus 25 mana. Early elemental spells. Dedicated random surges are in development.
trait_ama_origin_aberrant_info: Health and attack speed, plus 30 arcane mana. Manifestation and vital energy. Dedicated mental powers are in development.
trait_ama_origin_clockwork_info: Arcane order: armor and attack speed, plus 15 mana. Protection, manifestation and transformation. Dedicated temporal balance is in development.
trait_ama_origin_elemental_info: Preserved prototype origin: elemental damage, plus 20 arcane mana. Keeps the early Evocation curriculum.
trait_ama_origin_fey_info: Preserved prototype origin: armor and attack speed, plus 15 arcane mana. Manifestation and transformation.
